name: Ishihara Masaru
source: A freshman at Seishou Academy. His personality is too serious, but somehow he's kind of airhead. Masaru admires [url=/c54349]Hayashida Kyouhei[/url], which is the reason why he joined the baseball club despite of not athletically good. By the advisor order, Masaru becomes a cross-dressing manager, and is called "Yuu". "Yuu" is now becomes the obedient, sexual urges target of teachers and fellow members.
